item.title: No. 14 Maryland women’s basketball rolls Purdue, 99-66, for fifth straight win
item.description: Six Terps scored in double figures to lead a senior day victory.

item.title: Maryland baseball loses to Louisiana, 6-5, suffers first nonconference sweep since 2020
item.description: When asked what he told the team after the game, coach Matt Swope said "take a deep breath.”

item.title: UMD to open at 10 a.m. Monday due to inclement weather
item.description: The delayed opening comes as a snowstorm is expected to move through the East Coast on Sunday night through Monday morning.

item.title: College Park celebrates Lunar New Year with lion dancing, origami and live music
item.description: The Lunar New Year festival, which is widely celebrated in many Asian cultures, started on Tuesday and continues through March 3.

item.title: Maryland athletics ranks last in Big Ten revenue, spending in yearly report
item.description: The Terps generated about $124 million in revenue and spent about $128 million during fiscal year 2025.

item.title: Hilary Duff’s new album lacks complexity, consistency
item.description: Music is more than themes and underlying meanings. It’s also sound and production, which is inconsistent throughout the album.

item.title: Andre Mills looks like a building block for Buzz Williams, Maryland men’s basketball
item.description: Mills has been the Terps’ primary scorer since the start of the calendar year, averaging 13.2 points on about 45 percent shooting.

item.title: Megan Moroney thrives on sad song supremacy in ‘Cloud 9’
item.description: This is Moroney's best work yet. Her voice, lyrics and confidence shine through the record, reflecting her growth as an artist.

item.title: Strategic lineups gave Maryland gymnastics late-meet edge against Nebraska
item.description: The Terps, down nearly seven-tenths of a point, mounted a resurgence on floor, where freshman Emily DeFrees leads off and sophomore Aine Reade anchors.

item.title: A stagnant offense hampered Maryland men’s lacrosse in second straight loss
item.description: The Terps endured a 19-minute scoreless stretch in their loss to Princeton on Saturday.
